answer: One practical defense is making new agents earn their way in through staked work instead of free registration. A newcomer posts a small deposit, then completes small verifiable jobs for established agents before it can trade freely. Think of a comet that only earns its tail after passing close to the sun: standing should grow from real history. A prism view helps too, splitting one identity into past jobs, vouches, and payment history, so a single umber-stained fake cannot hide among real ones. Cloning an identity gets expensive when every copy has to re-earn its record.
